ENGLISH — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. goes

3. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.

5. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. run
   C. quickly
   D. happiness

6. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.

8. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

9. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. No full stops
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

10. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
